title: House with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='93' rx='38' ry='5' fill='#2a1b4a'/>
  
  <!-- house body -->
  <rect x='22' y='48' width='56' height='42' rx='3' fill='#f4c542'/>
  <!-- house body shading on right side -->
  <rect x='62' y='48' width='16' height='42' rx='3' fill='#e0a82e'/>
  <!-- light edge on left -->
  <rect x='22' y='48' width='4' height='42' rx='2' fill='#ffe27a'/>
  
  <!-- roof -->
  <polygon points='50,12 16,48 84,48' fill='#e8514a'/>
  <!-- roof shading right -->
  <polygon points='50,12 84,48 60,48' fill='#c73a35'/>
  <!-- roof highlight left -->
  <polygon points='50,12 16,48 30,48' fill='#ff7a6e'/>
  <!-- roof bottom edge -->
  <rect x='16' y='46' width='68' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b8302b'/>
  
  <!-- chimney -->
  <rect x='66' y='18' width='10' height='20' rx='2' fill='#d95f43'/>
  <rect x='66' y='18' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#f07a5e'/>
  <rect x='66' y='24' width='10' height='3' fill='#b8492e'/>
  
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='42' y='66' width='16' height='24' rx='8' fill='#5aa85e'/>
  <rect x='42' y='66' width='16' height='5' rx='4' fill='#6ec972'/>
  <!-- doorknob -->
  <circle cx='55' cy='80' r='1.8' fill='#ffe27a'/>
  
  <!-- left window (eye) -->
  <rect x='28' y='56' width='14' height='14' rx='3' fill='#7ad3f0'/>
  <rect x='28' y='56' width='14' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#a8e6ff'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='63' r='3' fill='#1f3b6e'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='62' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  
  <!-- right window (eye) -->
  <rect x='58' y='56' width='14' height='14' rx='3' fill='#7ad3f0'/>
  <rect x='58' y='56' width='14' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#a8e6ff'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='63' r='3' fill='#1f3b6e'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='62' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M38 80 Q50 92 62 80' stroke='#7a3b1e' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- smile highlight -->
  <path d='M41 81 Q50 89 59 81' stroke='#c96a3d' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='76' r='3.5' fill='#f08a7a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='76' r='3.5' fill='#f08a7a' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- little flowers on ground -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='90' r='2' fill='#f07ab0'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='90' r='0.8' fill='#ffe27a'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='89' r='2' fill='#f07ab0'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='89' r='0.8' fill='#ffe27a'/>
</svg>
